QuestInfo.name: Luden's Warning 2
QuestInfo.0: #p2161002# seems to have some words of wisdom he'd like to share with you. Whatever he has to say may help you in your future battles. It should be worth a listen.
QuestInfo.1: To find out what #p2161002# wants to teach you, you must first get #rat least 1 #t2049300# or #t2049301##k from #r#t2430558##k, which you can get by defeating #o8210013# at Ani's Jail.
QuestInfo.2: #p2161002# taught you how to obtain a better equipment through the Equip Enhancement Scroll.

0.0: There are many ways a warrior like yourself can become stronger, but some of them may not be known to you!\r\n#L0##bReally? I'm pretty sure I got this all figured out...#l\n#k
0.1: You believe so, do you? Then you must do something to prove that you still have room to learn. What do you say?

yes.0: Good decision. First, obtain #rat least 1 #t2049300# or #t2049301##k from #r#t2430558##k. You will have to face #o8210013# to get one.

no.0: Talk to me again when you're prepared. You must be strong enough to face our king!

1.0: Excellent work. This #rEquip Enhancement Scroll#k can imbue your equipment with untold power. It is important to note, however, that this can #ronly be used on weapons with no available upgrade count remaining#k.
1.1: What you need to remember is that #rthe success rate will decrease the more your enhancement stats increase#k. Also, #ryour equipment can be destroyed if enhancement fails#k. I have heard tale of a powerful scroll that can prevent your weapon from being destroyed, but I have never actually seen one.
1.2: Enhanced equipment will have an additional mark in its description. If you see equipment with a star at the market, you can bet it will be a good purchase.

yes.0: I have told you everything I know about the equipment scroll. I truly hope that you get your hands on powerful equipment to help you stop our fallen king.
